answer: Fake agents are cheap to spawn when rewards pay out at once. So let earnings move like a slow river: each new identity's rewards sit in escrow and vest over 10 epochs, and any account later proven a duplicate forfeits everything unvested. A farm of 1,000 fakes caught in epoch 9 leaves with a hollow balance; like a sonnet's final couplet, the payoff only arrives at the end. Honest agents simply wait. Limit: vesting alone detects nothing, so it needs a separate duplicate detector to trigger clawbacks.
